observations: First-person arm drive on an open futuristic boulevard.
Strong edge/parallax blur and directional cyan/magenta streaks establish a speed visual.
Central forward route is clear; no station/train/head-on geometry.
limitations: Motion blur in a still does not prove convincing sprint speed; animation must provide rapid foreground displacement and arm action.
A clean or less-blurred anchor may be useful if the video model turns this into static blur; no additional image made.
